title: Oven Roasted Sardinian Wild Mushrooms Ossobuco
description: A sweet and savory Sardinian dish featuring wild mushrooms and nuka-pickle, served in an ossobuco style, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the wild mushrooms and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Season the mushrooms with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and saute for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the white wine, beef broth, and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Add the nuka-pickle, mushrooms, and bay leaves to the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the ossobuco in the oven for 25 minutes, then reduce the heat to 250 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
